title: Objective Auto-run controls UI hardening — fail-closed canonical controls, exact-body retry, identity validation
description: Owner-facing Auto-run controls on /app/objectives/:id — canonical GET /auto-policy polled 5s while visible (abort-per-tick, no stale overwrite). R1 audit corrections: F1 driver readiness is eligibility-only — READY/NOT READY badges + driver_missing verbatim, no running-work claim; F2 fail-closed controls — mutation buttons exist ONLY when a canonical status for this identity has loaded (polCtl=polCanon), cockpit snapshot renders as labeled non-authoritative observation, GET 401/403/409/500/network error blocks all mutations + typed error + explicit Retry status button; F3 exact-body retry — submitted bodies (action, policy_version, limits, halt params, idempotency key) stored verbatim in pendingOps keyed by action:objective:version:limits signature, ambiguous transport failure replays identical bytes, definitive 409 CAS discards the stale op + refetches canonical state + requires re-confirmation minting a new operation key; F4 canonical identity — response objective_id+business_id must equal route/selection else typed IDENTITY_MISMATCH failure with controls closed, late responses aborted per tick; F5 adversarial evidence — GET 403/500 zero-POST, driver_ready≠running, exact-body replay, CAS→new-op-key, identity-mismatch closed controls, hidden-tab poll pause/resume. Zero backend/scheduler/schema changes. e2e objectives.spec.ts 30/30 pass; tsc+vite build clean; known baseline: P15.9-B5.4 'policy HALT' double-click flake (passes isolated).
